transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for about nine months now. There is just this constant, heavy feeling of emptiness inside me that won't go away. I feel completely down all the time.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt abnormally happy, irritable, or had increased energy, even if it was just for a short time?
No, I haven't really felt that way at all. I've mostly just felt deeply down and exhausted all the time. I don't ever remember having bursts of high energy or feeling happy like that.
I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch what you said. Could you please repeat your question?
Can you tell me more about the nine months you've been feeling this way - have you had any periods where your symptoms improved for a little while, or has it been constant?

It has been completely constant the entire time. I haven't had any periods where I felt better or got any relief from the depression and exhaustion. It's just been a heavy weight every single day for the last nine months.
How have you been able to manage your daily activities, such as work, socializing, or taking care of yourself, while feeling this way for the past nine months?

Managing daily life has been incredibly difficult because I barely have the energy or motivation to keep up with work and basic chores. I feel constantly exhausted both physically and mentally, so I've pulled away from my family and friends because I just don't have the strength to socialize anymore.
Have you experienced any episodes of depression like this before, or is this the first time you've felt this way for an extended period?
No, I've never gone through anything like this before. This is the first time I've felt this way, and it has just been going on continuously for the last nine months.

You've mentioned this has been going on for nine months, but can you clarify if you've had any periods of at least two weeks where your depressive symptoms were particularly severe, or has the intensity been relatively consistent throughout?

It has felt pretty consistently heavy and difficult throughout the entire nine months. I haven't really noticed any distinct periods where it suddenly got much worse for a couple of weeks. It's just been a steady, exhausting struggle every single day.

Can you describe how your low mood and other depressive symptoms have affected your daily life and relationships over the past nine months, and have you noticed any patterns or changes in your symptoms over time?

Over these nine months, I've completely withdrawn from my relationships because I feel too emotionally numb and exhausted to socialize, and even basic daily tasks feel impossible due to a total loss of motivation. As for patterns, I've noticed that any unusual experiences, like hearing voices or feeling paranoid, only ever happen when my depression is at its absolute worst.

Can you tell me more about these unusual experiences, such as hearing voices or feeling paranoid, that you mentioned happen when your depression is at its worst - how often do they occur and what do they feel like?

When my depression is at its worst, I hear faint whispering voices even when I'm completely alone in the room. I also get this intense, scary feeling that people are watching me or want to harm me, but these experiences only happen when I am feeling deeply depressed.
Do these voices and paranoid feelings seem to be connected to your depressive thoughts, or do they seem to be separate and unrelated to your feelings of sadness and emptiness?
Yes, they are directly connected to my depression. They only ever happen when I am feeling deeply sad, empty, and completely down, and I never experience them when I'm not in that low state.
